other_conditions: Applicant must be a beneficiary of the Delhi Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, Minorities, and Safai Karamchari Finance and Development Corporation (DSFDC).
Applicant must have availed a loan from DSFDC.
Applicant must be registered online under Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSME) at www.udyogaadhar.gov.in.
Eligibility category noted in source: Minority
Eligibility category noted in source: Safai Karamchari
Eligibility category noted in source: Persons with Disabilities
benefits_summary: Financial support is provided to artisans for participation in national fairs and exhibitions, covering travel, lodging, daily allowances and related expenses.
documents_required: Prescribed application form (hard copy or downloaded)
